note: Opening Day for the Hold the Hill board. It runs for 24 hours from the board's openingDay stamp (set by 🏁 Fresh start); start/end here are a fallback. Add drops any time: icon, title, body (or html), and at (ISO time; leave it out to show from the start). Newer drops show first, with a NEW tag for 2 hours.

drops.title: From the booth
drops.body: Fresh season, clean slate: every record is 0-0, every Brawl Bucks wallet starts over, and the ladder is set in sign-up order. Charge early, charge often.

drops.title: The champ gets the ball
drops.body: The Black Friday Brawl champion opens the season on the mound as the Ace. Every defense pays more than the last, so the first club to knock them off ends a reign before it gets going.

drops.title: Opening Day concession stand
drops.body: Free hot dogs (imaginary), free peanuts (also imaginary), and very real bragging rights for the first club to climb three spots today.
